critical_code_review_comments: auth.py send_otp_email is correctly implemented: reply_to omitted when SENDER_EMAIL empty (was empty string before — a known Gmail spam signal), List-Unsubscribe/List-Unsubscribe-Post/X-Entity-Ref-ID all present, tags[category=auth,type=otp] added for Resend deliverability analytics. Consider adding List-ID header (RFC 2919) alongside List-Unsubscribe for even stronger deliverability signal — Gmail treats bulk/transactional mail with List-ID more predictably. Optional.
